{{Top|leg}}
An '''Infrared Adaptor''' was a targeting [[Scope/Legends|scope]] component. The [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] had a [[Scope/Legends|sight]] with an Infrared Adaptor built into it that provided low-light enhancement for combat engagements at night.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
